candidates.statement: This guidance should be used in conjunction with the MHRA’s guidance on the Windsor Framework including UK-wide licensing for human medicines, and labelling and packaging guidance.
candidates.context: These changes will be implemented from 1 January 2025. This guidance should also be used to supplement the operational guidance in the MHRA’s existing guidance on pharmacovigilance procedures.
